title: Research: find repeatable high-volatility time windows (session opens, funding times, hour-of-week) per symbol where a short directional trade is predictable net of cost; then strategy, ML and desk branches for the windows that qualify
note: [Manager Session 2026-10-31a, ~11:10Z] OPERATOR ASK 2026-10-31, verbatim excerpt: 'it can also be a strategy ... focused on, say, catching a big breakout at, like, the first half hour or hour of trading, like, find those, like, volatile times in the markets and see if we can get a strategy that does short trades just during those specific times ... We should see if the desk can do that, but also if we can get like a strategy and ML up for something like that as well. So we should do like a scan of some symbols ... It doesn't even need to be opening hours, just where we can find like specific repeatable hours that have a lot of volatility, where we can think we can identify it regularly enough to capitalize on that.' Shape: ONE authoring lane writes a pre-registered stage-A scan unit (runner compute, no Claude cost) plus conditional follow-on nodes (Stage-0 strategy, ML direction head, desk time-window trigger) gated on the scan's verdict. Theme timeframes. Prior art: scripts/backtest_orb.py is fee-only (excluded from any promotion corpus).  [RESEARCH-OPS-20261031-2110] Stage A graded FAIL (0/8128 shortlisted); three conditional nodes moot; variant P3-VOLWIN-A2-longer-hold filed in programme 03. MOVEMENT-CAPTURE (lane RESEARCH-EDGE, unit RQ-20261101-58e4-06, PR #22117, operator direction 2026-11-01 ~11:46Z): FAIL. Volatility IS predictable: EWMA(0.94) of the daily range vs realised range, Spearman 0.575 / 0.541 / 0.478 / 0.502 / 0.509 for 2020..2024, pooled over 10 liquid perps. But 8 pre-registered two-sided bracket configs (breakout and fade at +/- a*R_hat, TP b*R_hat, SL c*R_hat, 1h bars, 14 bps round trip) ALL lose net: breakout -5.0 to -2.0 Sharpe, fade -1.3 to -1.9, best (FD1 gated) -0.72, stress -1.41; 1 of 4 years positive; short side -0.80 vs long +0.18. Engine checked on planted paths. The ML vol head was not reachable (trainer-resident) so it is untested; it must beat this EWMA baseline. Next idea with a payer: size the vol-predictability into RISK (vol-targeting) rather than into entries, or an options-like payoff; neither is a linear bracket.
